summary: Learn AI ethics, bias detection, and governance controls with practical tools, assessments, and reporting. Book training for your team.
lede: AI ethics, bias and regulation training helps professionals responsible for AI governance and model risk review assess systems and document decisions. The course covers bias measurement, risk classification and algorithmic impact assessments, alongside transparency, privacy controls and human oversight. Learners also practise mapping governance responsibilities, tracking remediation and preparing reports for leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to govern AI responsibly, review model risk, and document compliance decisions across the organisation.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: You should have a working understanding of AI concepts, machine learning terminology, and organisational risk or compliance processes. Familiarity with data governance, privacy principles, or model evaluation is helpful, but you do not need to code in Python to complete the course. Advanced topics such as fairness testing and governance automation are taught at an operational application level, not as software engineering or model-building depth.
